name: AcceptedMigrationRunner

file_contract.filename: four-digit sequence + underscore + lowercase slug + .sql; example 0001_foundation.sql
canonical_bytes: LF only; any CR byte is invalid
SHA-256 hashes these exact accepted bytes; runtime never normalizes before hashing

manifest_validation: sequence starts at 1 and is contiguous
sequence, migration_id and filename are unique
every listed file exists and no migration-shaped file is unlisted
each raw file hash exactly matches manifest before any database mutation

statement_parser.method: accumulate source lines and use sqlite3.complete_statement() to find SQLite statement boundaries; execute each complete non-comment/non-whitespace statement with Connection.execute()
statement_parser.reason: sqlite3.executescript() is forbidden because it may create implicit transaction boundaries and defeat schema+ledger atomicity
statement_parser.eof_rule: any non-whitespace/non-comment incomplete tail is MIGRATION_SYNTAX_INCOMPLETE
statement_parser.parameter_rule: accepted migration SQL contains no runtime/user values; data-dependent migration logic requiring Python must be a separately reviewed migration type rather than hidden string substitution

ledger_reconciliation: database ledger must be an exact prefix of accepted manifest for supported states
for every ledger row sequence/migration_id/sha256 must match manifest exactly
ledger row not represented by package manifest is UNSUPPORTED_FUTURE_VERSION or LEDGER_MISMATCH according to sequence
manifest entry preceding a missing ledger entry is pending; later ledger entries after a gap are LEDGER_MISMATCH
never update ledger hashes/IDs to make drift disappear
existing_database_apply: for each pending migration open verified migration connection
insert schema_migrations row using plain INSERT with current UTC whole-second recording time and app version
on any failure execute ROLLBACK and stop; later migrations are not attempted
after all pending migrations verify release schema manifest, foreign_key_check, FK-index coverage and append-only triggers before readiness
clean_initialization: if canonical database does not exist, create a uniquely named temporary database in the same data directory
use DELETE journal + FULL synchronous during unpublished initialization so only the main temporary file must be published
apply all accepted migrations and all post-migration verification to the temporary database
close all connections and remove temporary journal artifacts
atomically os.replace temporary database to canonical path
open canonical database, establish/verify WAL runtime mode, then continue startup
failure before replace removes only the temporary initialization artifacts and leaves canonical path absent
accepted_migration_policy: once migration is accepted, sequence/id/filename/raw bytes/hash/manifest entry freeze
changes require a new forward migration
pre-acceptance candidates may be rewritten only on explicitly disposable development databases
release/build verification rejects CRLF checkout drift rather than silently canonicalizing it
